AI Binance Trader v1.0.0 - APK Download package
===============================================
Contains:
- AI-Binance-Trader-v1.0.0-debug.apk (5.5 MB) - Installable on Android 8.0+
- AI-Binance-Trader-v1.0.0-release.aab (Play Store bundle)
- AI-Binance-Trader-Source-v1.0.0.zip (full source)
- index.html (install guide)

Install: Phone -> Settings -> Install unknown apps -> File Manager enable -> Tap APK -> Install -> Open

Security: No secrets in APK, backend-only signing, Testnet default.
